description: Header file defining the TServerSocket class, which implements a server socket transport for Thrift, including socket configuration, callbacks, and socket management.

classes.name: TServerSocket
classes.description: A server socket transport class for Thrift, supporting socket configuration, callbacks, and socket management.

methods.name: TServerSocket
methods.description: Constructors for TServerSocket with various parameters (port, address, unix socket path).

methods.name: ~TServerSocket
methods.description: Destructor for TServerSocket.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the server socket is open.

methods.name: setSendTimeout
methods.description: Sets the socket send timeout.

methods.name: setRecvTimeout
methods.description: Sets the socket receive timeout.

methods.name: setAcceptTimeout
methods.description: Sets the accept timeout.

methods.name: setAcceptBacklog
methods.description: Sets the backlog for incoming connections.

methods.name: setRetryLimit
methods.description: Sets the retry limit for socket operations.

methods.name: setRetryDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay between retries.

methods.name: setKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables or disables TCP keep-alive.

methods.name: setTcpSendBuffer
methods.description: Sets the TCP send buffer size.

methods.name: setTcpRecvBuffer
methods.description: Sets the TCP receive buffer size.

methods.name: setListenCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be called before listen.

methods.name: setAcceptCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be called after accept.

methods.name: setInterruptableChildren
methods.description: Enables or disables interruptible child sockets.

methods.name: getSocketFD
methods.description: Returns the server socket file descriptor.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the unix socket path if applicable.

methods.name: isUnixDomainSocket
methods.description: Checks if the socket is a Unix domain socket.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Interrupts the server socket.

methods.name: interruptChildren
methods.description: Interrupts child sockets.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server socket.
